subject: can we use several time geom_errorbar in the same plot?

messages.author: df0e7ad14078e8a9
messages.subject: can we use several time geom_errorbar in the same plot?
parts:
Hi,

Not sure the subject is clear, I would like to plot on the same graph
2 sets of data points, each one is of different length and has its own
errors associated with it.

Cheers

Vincent Margerin


x4 <- c(330, 835, 317, 396, 486, 391)
y4 <- c(4098.11, 4099.14, 4098.16, 4098.35, 4099.30, 4096.73)
y4b <- c(0.47, 0.29, 0.46, 0.83, 0.72, 0.87)
t4 <- sum(y4/y4b)/(sum(1/y4b))

x5 <- c(721, 257, 204, 271)
y5 <- c(4096.33, 4095.51, 4095.29, 4095.19)
y5b <- c(0.10, 0.15, 0.18, 0.22)
t5 <- sum(y5/y5b)/(sum(1/y5b))

dat.tgg817a <- data.frame(x4, y4, y4b)
dat.tgg817b <- data.frame(x5, y5, y5b)

xplot4 <- seq(100,1000)
yplot4 <- t4
xplot5 <- seq(100,1000)
yplot5 <- t5

x45 <- c(x4, x5)
y45 <- c(y4, y5)
y45b <- c(y4b, y5b)


### I tried to do the following but does not work
# qplot(x4, y4, ylim=c(4094,4101)) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= y4 - y4b,
ymax= y4 + y4b), width = 3, col='NavyBlue') +
geom_line(aes(xplot4,yplot4), col='NavyBlue', cex=2) +
geom_point(aes(x5, y5), col='DarkRed') + geom_line(aes(xplot5,yplot5),
col='DarkRed', cex=2) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= y5 - y5b, ymax= y5 +
y5b), width = 3, col='DarkRed')

### Used this very poor method but it's not nice
qplot(x45, y45, ylim=c(4094,4101)) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= y45 -
y45b, ymax= y45 + y45b), width = 3) + geom_point(aes(x5, y5),
col='Red') + geom_point(aes(x4, y4), col='RoyalBlue') +
geom_line(aes(xplot4,yplot4), col='NavyBlue', cex=1.5) +
geom_line(aes(xplot5,yplot5), col='DarkRed', cex=1.5)

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: can we use several time geom_errorbar in the same plot?
parts:
You're doing something quite complicated, perhaps it's time you use
ggplot() instead of qplot(). Try putting all of your vectors into 1 or
2 data.frame(s) and redoing the plot (like so)...

x4 <- c(330, 835, 317, 396, 486, 391)y4 <- c(4098.11, 4099.14,
4098.16, 4098.35, 4099.30, 4096.73)y4b <- c(0.47, 0.29, 0.46, 0.83,
0.72, 0.87)y4min<-y4-y4by4max<-y4+y4b
dat.tgg817a <- data.frame(x4, y4, y4b,y4max, y4min)

4095.19)y5b <- c(0.10, 0.15, 0.18, 0.22)y5min<-y5-y5by5max<-y5+y5b
dat.tgg817b <- data.frame(x5, y5, y5b, y5max, y5min)
t5 <- sum(y5/y5b)/(sum(1/y5b))

ggplot()+geom_point(data=dat.tgg817a, aes(x=x4,
y=y4))+geom_errorbar(data=dat.tgg817a, aes(x=x4, y=y4, ymin= y4min,
ymax= y4max), width = 3,
colour='NavyBlue')+geom_hline(aes(yintercept=t4), colour ='NavyBlue',
size=2)+geom_point(data=dat.tgg817b, aes(x=x5, y=y5),
colour='DarkRed') + geom_hline(aes(yintercept=t5), colour ='DarkRed',
size=2) + geom_errorbar(data=dat.tgg817b, aes(x=x5, y=y5, ymin= y5min,
ymax= y5max), width = 3,
colour='DarkRed')+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(4094,4101), wise=TRUE)

On Wed, Nov 16, 2011 at 01:19, Vincent Margerin
<vincenzo...@gmail.com> wrote:
>
> qplot(x45, y45, ylim=c(4094,4101)) + geom_errorbar(aes(ymin= y45 -
> y45b, ymax= y45 + y45b), width = 3) + geom_point(aes(x5, y5),
> col='Red') + geom_point(aes(x4, y4), col='RoyalBlue') +
> geom_line(aes(xplot4,yplot4), col='NavyBlue', cex=1.5) +
> geom_line(aes(xplot5,yplot5), col='DarkRed', cex=1.5)
